items: **Canadian leadership links:** Alter Domus's new non-executive chair **André Bourbonnais** (appointed Oct 21, 2026) and previous chair **Mark Wiseman** (former CEO of the Canada Pension Plan Investment Board) both come from Canadian pension investing.
**Same client world:** Montreal hosts major private-markets investors such as **CDPQ** and **PSP Investments**: the fund managers Alter Domus serves.
**No shared employer, school or contact verified** (check LinkedIn).

lead_with.title: A first Canadian base, in New York hours
lead_with.text: Alter Domus has nine US offices and none in Canada. A Finance Montréal-commissioned Boyd study puts a 150-person financial operation at about **US$18.9M a year in Montreal vs US$35.3M in New York**, in the New York time zone. Fund accounting, loan administration and investor reporting can run from Montreal for North American clients.

lead_with.title: The IFC credit covers fund work
lead_with.text: Quebec's **International Financial Centre** credit can reach **C$18,000 per eligible employee per year**, including for services provided under contract to a **foreign affiliate** (compliance, data, IT, fund and transaction support). Eligibility is checked case by case. **Fund administration and middle-office** support for foreign affiliates is a core use case.

lead_with.title: Fund services peers and investors
lead_with.text: **State Street** runs a large Montreal operation, and Montreal is home to **CDPQ** and a major **PSP Investments** office, plus **120,000+ finance and insurance** professionals.

Her location, client segment (private equity, real assets or debt), prior roles and education are **to be confirmed**: her LinkedIn profile is not indexed by search engines. Being in sales, she may also see Finance Montréal as a **door to Canadian fund managers**: be ready for that.

company.text: Alter Domus provides fund administration, depositary, AIFM, middle-office, loan agency and technology services to private markets managers. CEO **Charlotte Hogg** (since 2025). In 2026 it **acquired MSC Group** in Australia (May), won a **Bain Capital** credit mandate (Feb), supported Pantheon's first **US$1B** fund (Aug) and expanded in the **Nordics** (Oct). **André Bourbonnais** was named non-executive chair on Oct 21, 2026. Its North American growth came through acquisitions (Cortland Capital Market Services, IPS Fund Services) and US offices.

industry.title: Private markets outsourcing
industry.text: More private equity and credit managers outsource fund administration. Administrators compete on scale, technology and cost, so new delivery centres matter.

industry.title: Private credit boom
industry.text: Loan administration and agency work is growing fast and needs staff in North American hours.

industry.title: Canada's pension investors
industry.text: Canadian pension funds are among the world's largest private-markets investors; several are based in or have major offices in Montreal.

talking_points: How does Alter Domus serve **Canadian** fund managers and investors today, from the US?
